title: P2 worker.enroll: response
description: The worker and its token: the token is shown once and is stored only as a hash; the recorded tenant, role, kind, labels, plugins, placement and machine are what the core checks hello against (DEP-2); for the first channel process of a driver also the driver's P2 secret p2_token (D-87 (3)).

token.description: P1 worker token; passed in Authorization.

p2_token.description: Only for a channel process (kind channel): the P2 secret of the channel driver in the tenant, one per driver; issued at the first enroll of a process of this driver and at rotate_p2 (the previous one is valid until the end of the rotation window), shown once, only the hash is stored. By it the core finds the driver for checking Botaru-On-Behalf (D-87 (3)).
